notes: Angels of Delusion and Yunkui Summit, remade from scratch. Every character has a new sheet built from fresh research, one by one, with Google AI Mode and the wiki. Each sheet starts with who they really are, then how they talk, then a "what they would never do" list to keep them in character, then habits, the canon events that actually happened, relationships and looks. Body details are now just height and bra size, never full measurements. New scene prompts, openings and example scenes too. Angels of Delusion: you're still the new assistant manager, your own person, not the Proxy. Nangong is the smug prodigy who's secretly paying for everything, Aria switches between bubbly idol and shy construct, Sunna hides behind the amps, and Cecilia hums "hm?". Yunkui Summit: you're now the sect's newest disciple, junior to everyone. Fufu is thrilled to finally boss a new junior around, Belle is thrilled not to be the youngest anymore, Shunguang calls you "Little Junior", and Yixuan barely opens her eyes. Stories you already started keep their original setup; start a new story to play the new versions.
